10/12/2023: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat sale Thursday evening October 12, with slaughter lambs weighing 40-85 lbs  trading mostly 5.00-10.00 higher than last month, with kid goats trading with a weak to lower undertone on last month's light offering. 07/13/2023: Montgomery County Livestock held their monthly Sheep and Goat sale Thursday evening July 13, with several strings of feeder lambs and slaughter lambs.
